meta.title: SecHeaders Lab — passive website security review
meta.description: Grade a website's HTTP security headers, TLS, cookies and information disclosure from A+ to F, with copy-ready fixes for Nginx, Apache, IIS, Next.js, Netlify and Cloudflare.

footer.disclaimer: SecHeaders Lab performs a passive, read-only inspection of what a site already serves to every browser. It is not a penetration test and its results are informational. Only scan sites you are authorized to assess.
footer.privacy: No accounts, no analytics, no tracking. Scanned addresses and results are not stored.
footer.author: Built by Mohammed Alrabai

home.title: Grade your website's security headers in seconds
home.lead: A passive review of HTTP security headers, TLS, cookies and information disclosure, with a grade from A+ to F and copy-ready fixes for your server.

form.label: Website address
form.hint: Enter a domain or a full URL. Only the public response that every browser receives is read.
form.errorSummary: Check the address and try again.

errors.tooLong: The address is longer than 2,048 characters.
errors.controlChars: The address contains characters that are not allowed.
errors.scheme: Only http:// and https:// addresses can be scanned.
errors.credentials: Remove the user name and password from the address.
errors.port: Only the standard ports 80 and 443 can be scanned.
errors.ipLiteral: Enter a domain name, not an IP address.
errors.hostname: Enter a full domain name such as example.com.
errors.reserved: Local and internal names cannot be scanned.

passive.title: Passive and safe
passive.body: One normal page request and one TLS handshake. No probing, no payloads, nothing a regular visitor would not do.

fixes.title: Fixes for your server
fixes.body: Every finding explains why it matters and gives copy-ready configuration for Nginx, Apache, IIS, Next.js, Netlify and Cloudflare.

bilingual.title: English and Arabic
bilingual.body: The whole tool and its printable report work in both languages, with proper right-to-left layout.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Enter the address of a site you are allowed to assess.
how.step2: We fetch its homepage once, read the response headers and inspect the TLS certificate.
how.step3: You get a score, a grade and a fix for every finding.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.
